contradictions.source: Veniens incautus mas quidem erat tigris decidit in foueam
contradictions.english: A tiger, a male, came incautious, fell into the pit
contradictions.why: The source says 'mas quidem erat tigris' (the tiger was indeed a male), but the English phrasing implies the tiger was a male as a specific identifier, whereas the Latin text uses 'mas' to clarify the gender of the specific animal that fell.
